unscored_labels.label: Groan
unscored_labels.reason: A single voiced low-f0 swell is present at 10.87-11.15 s (5.9 dB above the 2.5 s preceding median in 20-250 Hz, voiced fraction 0.52, f0 108 Hz, no 1-8 kHz energy), which is what a short groan or low hum would look like. The label spans 10.4-11.8 s: its onset change is only +1.7 dB (percentile 0.59) and its offset +0.7 dB (0.26); the span's mean level equals the 2 s before it (+0.1 dB) and its 1-8 kHz content is 5.8 dB lower. So the acoustic event is about 0.3 s long and sits inside the labelled 1.4 s; both boundaries are off by 0.47 s (start) and 0.65 s (end).

unscored_labels.label: Footsteps
unscored_labels.reason: Cadence autocorrelation is low (max 0.16, median 0.10), but the clip has 23 unvoiced impulsive onsets in 15 s (1.5/s, median spacing 0.42 s, in the range of a walking cadence) in the same stretches as whispered speech, which Gemini itself describes. Steps and unvoiced whisper consonants cannot be separated with energy and pitch alone.
